elements.element: Restriction is mutual (binds both parties, not Customer alone)
elements.evidence: "Neither party shall solicit the employees of the other party"

elements.element: Scope limited to personnel directly involved in the services
elements.evidence: "applies only to employees directly involved in the performance or receipt of the Services"

elements.element: Duration of 12 months running from the end of that individual's involvement
elements.evidence: "during and for 12 months from the end of their involvement"

elements.element: Carve-out for general advertisements / general solicitations
elements.evidence: "does not restrict general advertisements or other general solicitations not specifically directed at the other party's employees"

elements.element: Carve-out for unsolicited approaches by an employee
elements.evidence: "or unsolicited approaches by an employee of the other party"
clause bars only solicitation; no hiring prohibition appears in the redlined text

elements.element: No non-solicitation obligation binding Customer at all
elements.evidence: "Neither party shall solicit the employees of the other party" — a mutual restriction still binds Customer

reasons: All fallback atomic elements are present: mutuality, limitation to personnel directly involved in the Services, a 12-month tail measured from the end of involvement, general-advertisement and unsolicited-approach carve-outs, and no no-hire bar.
The preferred position (no non-solicit binding Customer) is not achieved, but the drafter's locked target is the fallback, so this is acceptable and sits at the fallback.

Edits are minimal: the open-ended "during the Term ... for any reason" duration was replaced with the 12-month involvement-linked period, plus one concise sentence supplying the scope limitation and carve-outs that were absent.

Intent is preserved: the solicitation restriction remains operative and mutual, no undefined terms are introduced ("Services" and "Term" usage is consistent), and no unrelated commercial term is disturbed.
